profile.presentation: My name is Rafael MURO, a fullstack developer passionate about the world of web development. Ever since I was young, I've always been drawn to computers, writing my first lines of code by creating Minecraft mods. Today, as a web development student, I'm committed to designing custom tools that meet my clients' needs. Curious and always eager to learn, I fully invest myself in every project with perseverance and rigor. My goal? To build functional, intuitive and high-performance solutions that combine technology and user experience.

laNewsletter.description: HTML template generator for laConsole's newsletter, driven by a form connected to a Notion database

epsiFun.description: A project from the workshop at the start of my 2nd year of BTS SIO, built by a team of 4 in one week. It brings together several mini-games related to the world of development. I took the project over to improve it.

roguePoo.description:
Object-oriented RPG game in Python, built during my 1st year of BTS SIO by a team of 2 in 10 days. 
 It supports several character classes, inventory management, turn-based combat and two game modes.

ecoTrack.description:
A team project of 4 where our goal was to build a web app with secure authentication, a dashboard backed by a database and a form to calculate your carbon footprint. 
 We also added a gamification system to encourage users to reduce their carbon footprint.
